hypothesis: Broad-market candidates with clear same-day score separation from the next candidate may represent cleaner leadership and lower crowding than clustered beta. A bounded default-off paper notional support scalar should only be retained if it clears a strict three-window materiality gate.
interpretation: Score-gap separation is a production-computable crowding/leadership quality surface aligned with the playbook's broad-market governance direction. Because it is still a frozen-window notional scalar, this run uses a strict materiality gate before any shared-adapter change.

protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market price-floor, rank-notional, low-extension ret5, high-volatility, trend-persistence, strong-close crowding, recent-repeat, absolute-score, trend-efficiency, red-day pullback, and max-daily-return variants were tested; score-gap-to-next crowding separation was not formalized for this sleeve.
